'''Hoth Pop''' was an item sold at [[Kwik-E-Mart]], a store on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At one point in [[Time/Legends|time]], the store listed Hoth Pop as a [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] special, stating the price of the item was .25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Prey">''[[Evasive Action: Prey]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hoth Pop was mentioned on a sign in ''[[Evasive Action: Prey]]'', a series of daily webstrips written by [[Paul Ens]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges]].<ref name="Prey" />
